prompt:
A motorized winch of efficiency 75% lifts a load of mass 120 kg vertically through a height of 18 m in a time interval of 15 s at constant speed. Take g = 9.81 m s^-2.
Calculate:
(a) the useful work done on the load [1]
(b) the useful power output delivered to the load [1]
(c) the electrical power input to the winch motor [1]

mark_scheme.criterion: (a) Calculates useful work: W = mgh = 120 * 9.81 * 18 = 21 200 J (accept 21.2 kJ or 21 190 J).
(b) Calculates useful power: P = W / t = 21 190 / 15 = 1410 W (accept 1400 W or 1.41 kW).
(c) Calculates electrical input power: P_in = P_useful / 0.75 = 1412.6 / 0.75 = 1880 W (accept 1900 W or 1.88 kW).

hints: In (a), useful work is the gain in gravitational potential energy mgh.
In (b), divide useful work by the time interval of 15 s.
In (c), apply efficiency = useful power / input power.
teacher_walkthrough: Part (a): Direct application of W = mgh = 120 * 9.81 * 18 = 21 190 J.
Part (c): Rearrange efficiency formula: P_in = P_useful / eta = 1413 / 0.75 = 1884 W.
